mechanism.name: rank-1 Kronecker surrogate for the shared young-source transport operator
mechanism.scope: Only V25 young dense A/P transports corresponding to the dense WD @ A_st[ka:k] and WD @ P_st[ka:k] path are replaced. Young D21 right-factor contractions, old tiers, Rres/MP-R16, lambda/feed logic, D3/D21 formulas, K4 regeneration, covariance, mean correction and final-layer trim remain unchanged.
production_rule: Form WD exactly as parent V25 on the metered fnp path.
Rearrange WD without numerical arithmetic from indices (i1,i2;j1,j2) to matrix R[(i1,j1),(i2,j2)].

Use fixed fnp-array power approximation once per layer: v0=fnp.ones(n); v0=v0/fnp.sqrt(fnp.sum(v0*v0)); u=R@v0; u=u/fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(fnp.sum(u*u),1e-30)); v=R.T@u. No Python-scalar normalization is allowed.
Set A=reshape(u,(32,32)), B=reshape(v,(32,32)); the surrogate operator is A kron B but must not be materialized densely.
Apply A kron B to every young A/P transport by reshape plus two batched fnp.einsum/matmul contractions implementing Y=A X B^T for each transported column.
No target, network ID, score, per-network rank, threshold, seed or tuned parameter enters the rule. Off official n=1024 shape, use unchanged parent transport rather than infer a new d.

novelty_firewall.r247: Different operation and representation: R247 sparsified young D21 contraction right factors; R248 leaves those contractions exact and approximates the shared young transport operator with a Kronecker product.
novelty_firewall.r244: No Rres rank-16 or marginal-preserving projection.
novelty_firewall.rank_age_tiers: No source age/rank/tier change and no source-axis compression.
novelty_firewall.sketches_sampling: No randomized contraction estimator, CountSketch, TensorSketch, FWHT, QMC or source sampling.
novelty_firewall.fast_matmul: No Strassen/Winograd/trilinear-aggregation bilinear schedule; this changes the transport operator representation approximately.
novelty_firewall.history_search: research/history.json (194 experiments, blob 8f94f371572fedbd8c1ebd9d19cc48ca837592fb) contains no Kronecker/kron/tensor-product/HODLR/butterfly mechanism string; upstream findings_log blob 09cf41e8826052ceb83109115cae688c03baaaca contains Kronecker only in cited exchangeability-delta theory, not as a V25 transport approximation experiment.

source_compliance.rule_from_r245: No output-affecting math.* in predict. Numerical sqrt/transcendentals must use metered fnp. Avoid nontrivial output-affecting Python-scalar arithmetic.
candidate_contract: No math import or math.* call in the candidate path.
All normalization uses fnp.sum/fnp.sqrt/fnp.maximum and fnp-array division.
All output-affecting linear algebra uses fnp reshape/transpose/matmul/einsum.
d=32 and official n=1024 are frozen integer shape constants; no Python numerical coefficient is derived from estimator values.
If implementation requires any nontrivial output-affecting Python-scalar numerical arithmetic beyond shape/index bookkeeping, eligibility becomes UNKNOWN and R248 must stop before public measurement.

falsifier.method: Oracle best rank-1 Kronecker approximation on deterministic synthetic transport operators. The oracle SVD is strictly more favorable than the frozen one-power production rule; oracle failure therefore rejects the candidate before implementation.
falsifier.go_iff: exact-Kronecker control <=1e-12; all 8 realistic cases finite/deterministic; every operator/A/P relative RMS <=0.015; mean over all realistic transported A/P relative RMS <=0.012
falsifier.failure_semantics: DEVELOPMENT NO-GO before estimator implementation, benchmark or Actions
